notes.title: Update v0.8 - Boss reworks, burn effects, new guns & items
notes.notes:
To anyone reading this, merry christmas you are COOL AS ****

This is another general improvement update. The main focus was making [b]bosses susceptible to player status effects and abilities[/b]. So now all but 1 boss (which I will fix) can be knocked back and slowed. I reworked the jungle boss entirely because of this. Added a [b]burn[/b] mechanic, which quickly damages enemies while ticking down it's damage. Added [b]3 new weapons[/b] and [b]2 new items[/b], mostly related to [b]burn[/b]. Added a bunch of other miscellaneous changes below. 

There will be another update very soon to do some visual fx with burn and more.

FULL CHANGELOG:
-Added "Fire Rock" item (chance to burn on hit)
-Added "Hot Knife" item (melee hits burn)
-Added "Flame Pistol" weapon (burns on hit)
-Added "Flame Shotgun" weapon (burns on hit)
-Bosses now bleed for 1% max health, but bleed slower. 
-Complete Jungle boss rework, can now be slowed and knocked back.
-Melee range is larger for all characters, does more damage, and has higher knockback, but is slower.
-Improved melee sound effect.
-Final boss heals at half HP.
-Added slight player movement acceleration.
-Added the burn status effect.
-Added icons to burn and bleed status effects.
-End of level teleporter spawns close to you when level is finished.
-Elites spawn more frequently, and can spawn earlier.
-Elites now drop either ammo, HP, or a weapon.
-Coins disappear after 10 seconds.
-Bullets change color depending on their status effect.
-Fixed some enemies not freezing correctly.
-Changed item unlock conditions for a few items.

Item changes:
-"Cracked horn" procs under 5 hp. (Old - procs under 6 max hp)
-"Cursed flame" decreases accuracy. (Old - decreases damage)
-"Knives" increase melee damage. (Old - increase melee speed)
-"Snowglobe" heals 1 HP at start of stage. (Old - Heal 1 HP at start if stage if under half health)
-"Silver Key" gives 1 armor. (Old - gives 1 HP)
-"Amulet" Increases ability charge rate. (Old - additional max ability slot)
-"Frozen Key" freeze time buffed to 5 seconds. (Old - 4 seconds)

notes.title: Update v0.7.0 - Across the Board
notes.notes:
This is a comprehensive update, with a lot of changes to a lot of systems. For starters, unique [b]ability slots[/b] will now [b]recharge[/b] when defeating enemies; no more having to scramble for an ammo chest surrounded by enemies. Also, defeating a boss spawns [b]3 artifacts of your choice[/b], for free! Check out some of the other important changes below~ 


[b]Full Changelog:[/b]
-Added weapon tier in form of roman numerals below weapons. (I, II, III, IV).
-Enemies spawn further away from the player on level entrance.
-Improved final boss phase 2 move set.
-Desert crawler's bomb indicators no longer overlap.
-Add flat damage negation to Elementals, and the final boss. (5 damage negation)
-Traps in the Castle area no longer stay active when level is clear.
-Fixed artifact 'Ice Cream' never spawning. (Chance to freeze enemies)
-Artifact 'Brand' is stronger, now applies to all types of damage dealt.
-Artifact 'Blood Money' does more damage. 
-Removed artifact 'Yoyo' for a rework.
-Choosing an artifact from a tree or shop equips it instantly.
-Movement speed artifacts are less jarring to pickup, and more balanced.
-Artifact tree now spawns in boss rooms, giving player 3 choices of a free artifact.
-Player abilities now charge when defeating enemies. Charge amount depends on how strong the enemy is.
-Increased cursor size.
-Added flavor text to loading screen.
-Bug/crash fixes.
-Lag fix when large amount of enemies are on screen.
